summary: A lobbyist waits to speak with a member as the member passes through the hall.
realLife: owner, Oct 27: A lobbyist can be a counterpart in an unplanned encounter at the seat of government.
inGame: The lobby-remembers situation supplies the lobbyist encounter; a hallway setting must fit the recorded circumstance.

turns.what: The member asks the lobbyist to send the material to the office after session.
turns.pulledBy: The floor bell cuts short the hallway encounter.
turns.writesBack: The office expects a document on the named bill.

turns.what: The lobbyist hands over a district map before the voting bell draws the member back inside.
turns.pulledBy: The map is available at the door and the member has time to take it but cannot hear the presentation.
turns.writesBack: The office files the map and logs the requested discussion as pending.
